		TacVerse: A Multi-scene Bimanual Visuo-Tactile Dataset
	




TacVerse is a large-scale bimanual manipulation dataset in which every frame carries
four streams of high-resolution visuotactile sensing — two per gripper — alongside the
synchronized camera views. It is collected with XTac-UMI-G1, a handheld UMI gripper pair
carrying Xense Neutron visuotactile sensors, across three real-world scene families —
office, home, and workbench.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/TacVerse/TacVerse.
